source_policy: Keep one hand-edited canonical cluster. Generate deterministic self-contained host projections by omitting declared source-only milestone artifacts, rewriting only cross-sibling reference locations, copying the referenced canonical bytes, and recording hashes. Hermes also receives a standard description override of at most 60 characters; no projection adds permissions.

codex.model_discovery: Controlled by each Skill's agents/openai.yaml policy.
codex.refresh: Start a new task or inspect /skills after installation.

claude-code.model_discovery: Description-based unless the user changes Claude-specific invocation controls in a private projection.
claude-code.refresh: Claude watches existing skill roots; restart if the root did not exist when the session started.

opencode.explicit_invocation: Name <skill-name> in the prompt so the agent loads it through the native skill tool. Stable slash-command behavior is not an official compatibility contract.
opencode.model_discovery: Advertised from name and description unless OpenCode permissions or metadata disable it.
opencode.refresh: Start or resume a session after the projected files are present.

hermes.project_scope_note: Hermes documents ~/.hermes/skills as its primary root. For a project-owned source, add that source to skills.external_dirs in ~/.hermes/config.yaml; this installer does not mutate host configuration.

description_overrides.engineering-research-copilot: 科研全流程/Research workflow；从想法、文献、计划、结果、草稿或审稿意见进入。
description_overrides.research-direction-evidence: 研究方向/Research direction；比较主方向、相邻方向、迁移探索与证伪检验。
description_overrides.research-literature-evidence: 文献检索/Literature evidence；分开发现、身份、摘要、全文和用户材料。
description_overrides.research-method-transfer: 科研方法/Method transfer；比较假设、适用性、反迁移因素和最小证伪检验。
description_overrides.research-manuscript: 论文写作/Manuscript；按主张—证据关系起草、改稿和润色。
description_overrides.research-cross-review: 交叉审阅/Cross review；保留独立审稿意见和分歧后再综合。
description_overrides.research-data-comparison: 数据对比/Data comparison；检查单位、配对、缺失、基线与不确定性。
description_overrides.research-evidence-adversary: 证据对抗/Adversarial audit；寻找反证、泄漏、替代解释和过度推断。
description_overrides.research-figure-workflow: 科研绘图/Scientific figures；按主张和数据选择图形并做质量审计。

hermes.model_discovery: Natural-language discovery through skills_list and skill_view.
hermes.refresh: Start a new session, use /reset, or apply the host's documented immediate refresh option.

openclaw.explicit_invocation: $<skill-name> in a prompt or /<skill-name> as a standalone command
openclaw.model_discovery: Eligible skills are indexed from their name and description subject to OpenClaw allowlists and gates.
openclaw.refresh: The watcher refreshes changed skills; a new session provides a clean snapshot.

github-copilot.model_discovery: Description-based unless Copilot permissions or frontmatter disable it.
github-copilot.refresh: Run /skills reload or start a new session.
